en.text: The neural lace is going to be critical for humans to keep up with AI.

zh.text: 神经织网对于人类跟上AI的步伐将是至关重要的。

en.text: In the long term, we need to merge with AI to remain relevant.

zh.text: 从长远来看，我们需要与AI融合才能保持相关性。

en.text: Neuralink's first human implant was a success. The patient is recovering well.

zh.text: Neuralink的首个人类植入物成功了。患者恢复良好。

en.text: We now have over 10 patients with Neuralink implants. The results are exceeding expectations.

zh.text: 我们现在有超过10名Neuralink植入患者。结果超出预期。

en.text: The goal of Neuralink is to create a high-bandwidth brain-computer interface.

zh.text: Neuralink的目标是创建一个高带宽的脑机接口。

en.text: Imagine being able to communicate at the speed of thought. That's what Neuralink enables.

zh.text: 想象一下能够以思维的速度进行交流。这就是Neuralink能够实现的。

en.text: The combination of Grok and Neuralink will be incredibly powerful. AI directly connected to the brain.

zh.text: Grok和Neuralink的结合将极其强大。AI直接连接到大脑。

en.text: Neuralink can help people with paralysis control devices with their thoughts.

zh.text: Neuralink可以帮助瘫痪患者用思维控制设备。

en.text: The first patient with a Neuralink implant was able to play chess using only his thoughts.

zh.text: 第一位Neuralink植入患者能够仅用思维下国际象棋。

en.text: Brain-computer interfaces are the future of human-computer interaction. Keyboards will seem primitive.

zh.text: 脑机接口是人机交互的未来。键盘将显得原始。

en.text: The Neuralink device is about the size of a coin. It's implanted in the skull and you can't even see it.

zh.text: Neuralink设备大约硬币大小。它植入头骨中，你甚至看不到它。

en.text: I think the first applications of Neuralink will be medical — helping people with neurological conditions.

zh.text: 我认为Neuralink的首次应用将是医学的——帮助有神经系统疾病的人。

en.text: Eventually, Neuralink will allow humans to download memories and upload thoughts.

zh.text: 最终，Neuralink将允许人类下载记忆和上传思想。

en.text: The surgery to implant Neuralink is minimally invasive. It's done by a robot in about 30 minutes.

zh.text: 植入Neuralink的手术是微创的。由机器人在大约30分钟内完成。

en.text: Our clinical trial results show that Neuralink is safe and effective. We're expanding the trial.

zh.text: 我们的临床试验结果表明Neuralink是安全有效的。我们正在扩大试验。

en.text: The long-term vision for Neuralink is a symbiotic relationship between humans and AI.

zh.text: Neuralink的长期愿景是人类与AI之间的共生关系。

en.text: I think within a decade, Neuralink will be widely available for medical applications.

zh.text: 我认为在十年内，Neuralink将在医学应用中广泛可用。

en.text: The threads in Neuralink are thinner than a human hair. They're inserted by a surgical robot.

zh.text: Neuralink中的线比人类头发还细。它们由手术机器人插入。

en.text: Neuralink patients have been able to control computers, play games, and communicate through thought alone.

zh.text: Neuralink患者已经能够仅通过思维控制计算机、玩游戏和交流。

en.text: The brain is like a computer. Neuralink is the USB port that lets you connect it to the digital world.

zh.text: 大脑就像一台计算机。Neuralink是让你将它连接到数字世界的USB端口。
